entities.summary: Ryan Poehling is an American professional ice hockey player who is a center for the Anaheim Ducks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the first round, 25th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2017 NHL entry draft. Poehling has also previously played for the Pittsburgh Penguins and Philadelphia Flyers.
